about: Schools CycleTrack does not list, kept by hand and carried into schools.json unchanged by scripts/medschools/build-registry.ts (buildRegistry's extras). Each is on an official list: MD programmes in the LCME directory of accredited US programs (lcme.org/directory/accredited-programs/, page updated 2026-11-13; preliminary accreditation is the stage at which a programme recruits and admits), DO colleges and campuses in the COCA COM directory (osteopathic.org, September 2026) and the AACOM US COM directory (aacom.org, 2026-11-17). A campus is its own entry when it admits its own class, as the registry already treats the PCOM, VCOM, Rocky Vista and WesternU campuses; a teaching site of one programme is not (MSUCOM Detroit and Macomb, OU-HCOM Cleveland and Dublin, Rowan-Virtua Sewell, NSU-KPCOM Clearwater, RVUCOM Southern Utah). They have no CYCLETRACK alias, so the alias files name them by shortName (registryKeyOf in features/medschools/scrape/registry.ts). Checked on 2026-11-24.
